lines.en: label iodorm15:
I knock on Io’s door and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Io 的门，等她来应门。

lines.en: But several seconds go by without a response and, given that she doesn’t normally work this late, I start to wonder if she might be out doing something else.
lines.zh: 可好几秒过去了都没有回应；考虑到她平时不会工作到这么晚，我开始怀疑她是不是出去做什么别的事了。

lines.en: But then I remember that this is Io we’re talking about, and that the likelihood of her actually doing anything other than working or hanging out in her room is practically zero.
lines.zh: 但接着我想起来，这可是 Io——她真的会去做除了打工或窝在房间里之外的事，概率基本为零。

lines.en: So I knock again.
lines.zh: 于是我又敲了一次。

lines.en: : Hey. Are you in there?
lines.zh: : 嘿。你在里面吗？

lines.en: Time starts to tick by and-
lines.zh: 时间一分一秒过去，然后——

lines.en: : Ngh...what?
lines.zh: : 唔……什么？

lines.en: : Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei？

lines.en: : Is that you?
lines.zh: : 是你吗？

lines.en: : Did I wake you up?
lines.zh: : 我把你吵醒了吗？

lines.en: : Not...exactly but...
lines.zh: : 也不……完全是，不过……

lines.en: : Can I come in?
lines.zh: : 我能进来吗？

lines.en: : Yeah...Let me just get this out of the way and-
lines.zh: : 可以……让我先把这个挪开，然后——

lines.en: : Ah!
Something falls over and hits the ground.
lines.zh: 有什么东西倒了，砸在地上。

lines.en: But considering there are roughly six million objects inside of Io’s room, things like this are bound to happen.
lines.zh: 不过考虑到 Io 房间里大概有六百万件东西，这种事迟早会发生。

lines.en: scene black
I’ll have to ask Ami to clean this room while Io is away since Uta is clearly incapable of fulfilling her maidly duties and-
lines.zh: 等 Io 不在的时候我得让 Ami 来打扫这间屋子，毕竟 Uta 显然没法尽到她作为女仆的职责，而且——

lines.en: scene iokotatsu1
: Ngh...
: Are you okay?
lines.zh: : 你还好吗？

lines.en: : Was that {i}you{/i} who fell just now?
lines.zh: : 刚才是{i}你{/i}摔倒了吗？

lines.en: : ...Probably.
lines.zh: : ……大概是。

lines.en: : I feel like that’s something you should know.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这种事你应该是知道的。

lines.en: : Just...a little out of it...
lines.zh: : 只是……有点神志不清……

lines.en: scene iokotatsu2
: So, uhh...
lines.zh: : 那么，呃……

lines.en: : What’s up?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？

lines.en: : What’s up is you’re either extremely tired or extremely drunk.
lines.zh: : 怎么了——你要么是累坏了，要么是醉坏了。

lines.en: : Or extremely messed up from mixing medications and not eating anything all day.
lines.zh: : 要么是混着吃药、又整天没吃东西，整个人乱套了。

lines.en: : Medication?
: It’s the fancy word for medicine.
lines.zh: : 就是「药」的比较高级的说法。

lines.en: : I know what it means, Io.
lines.zh: : 我知道那是什么意思，Io。

lines.en: : Cool. Then we can forget this happened and talk about something else.
lines.zh: : 酷。那我们就当没这回事，聊点别的吧。

lines.en: : The next time you don’t respond to my knocks, I’m just walking away.
lines.zh: : 下次你再不回应我敲门，我就直接走人了。

lines.en: : If you need rest or whatever, you shouldn’t be getting out of bed for me.
lines.zh: : 如果你需要休息什么的，就不该为了我起床。

lines.en: scene iokotatsu3
: I told you, I’m good. Just a little out of it.
lines.zh: : 我说了，我没事。只是有点神志不清。

lines.en: : This isn’t like, an abnormal thing. It happens all the time and it’s easily preventable.
lines.zh: : 这不算什么异常。经常发生，而且很容易预防。

lines.en: : I’m just a little dizzy.
lines.zh: : 我只是有点头晕。

lines.en: : Can you stand?
lines.zh: : 你能站起来吗？

lines.en: : Probably not. So if we could hang out on the ground, that would be cool.
lines.zh: : 大概不行。所以如果我们能在地上待着就太好了。

lines.en: : I mean...that doesn't exactly sound like a good time. But I don’t think it can be helped at this point.
lines.zh: : 我是说……听起来算不上多好玩。不过事到如今，恐怕也没别的办法了。

lines.en: : If you’re okay with catching me, I can try standing up.
lines.zh: : 要是你愿意接住我，我可以试着站起来。

lines.en: : You weigh probably just as much as my cell phone, so that much wouldn’t be a problem.
lines.zh: : 你大概跟我的手机一样重，所以这一点不成问题。

lines.en: : But I don’t think you should be overexerting yourself if you’re sick.
lines.zh: : 但我觉得你要是不舒服，就不该勉强自己。

lines.en: : I’m not {i}sick{/i} sick. I’m Io sick.
lines.zh: : 我不是{i}普通{/i}的生病。我是「Io 式生病」。

lines.en: : Is that some new form of debilitating disease?
lines.zh: : 那是某种新的衰弱性疾病吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. They made it just for me.
lines.zh: : 是啊。专门为我造的。

lines.en: : Really, though. What’s wrong?
lines.zh: : 说真的，到底怎么了？

lines.en: : It’s a secret.
lines.zh: : 这是秘密。

lines.en: : You hate secrets.
lines.zh: : 你讨厌秘密。

lines.en: : The pill bottles are right behind me and I’m in no shape to fight you.
lines.zh: : 药瓶就在我身后，而我现在这状态也没法跟你抢。

lines.en: : I mean, even if I wasn’t all messed up right now, I wouldn’t be in any shape to fight you. You’re really big.
lines.zh: : 我是说，就算我现在没有这么晕，我也打不过你。你块头太大了。

lines.en: : But go ahead and read them if you’re that curious. There are some pretty wild names on there.
lines.zh: : 不过你要是这么好奇，就去读吧。上面有些名字野得很。

lines.en: : Oh, and there are a couple more under the bed you can probably find if you lay down and move your arm around.
lines.zh: : 哦，床底下还有几个，你躺下伸手摸摸大概就能找到。

lines.en: : They fell off the mini fridge when I tried to make it to the door and now I'm gonna have to crawl under there and get them back.
lines.zh: : 我刚才想走到门口，它们从小冰箱上掉下去了，现在我得爬进去把它们捡回来。

lines.en: : I’d really prefer if you’d just tell me what's wrong so I don’t have to Google some complicated name that I won't even be able to say out loud.
lines.zh: : 我真更希望你能直接告诉我怎么了，这样我就不用去搜一个我连念都念不出来的复杂药名。

lines.en: : I mean, if it was just {i}one{/i} thing, I wouldn’t have so many different bottles, right?
lines.zh: : 我是说，如果只是{i}一种{/i}病，我也不会有一堆不同的药瓶了吧？

lines.en: : I’m all sorts of broken. I already told you this.
lines.zh: : 我浑身上下哪儿都坏。我跟你说过的。

lines.en: : You don’t look that broken to me.
lines.zh: : 我看着你可没那么坏。

lines.en: : And {i}you{/i} don’t look that broken to me. So we’re either really good at judging each other or really bad at it.
lines.zh: : 我看着{i}你{/i}也没那么坏。所以我们要么都很会看人，要么都很不会看人。

lines.en: : Why are you still standing?
lines.zh: : 你怎么还站着？

lines.en: : Because I don’t want you to throw up on me.
lines.zh: : 因为我不想你吐在我身上。

lines.en: scene iokotatsu4
: I’m not going to throw up on you.
lines.zh: : 我不会吐在你身上的。

lines.en: : Well, I probably would if you like, spun me around or something. But that’s not a thing you’ve done so far, so unless you’ve developed some weird new hobby...
lines.zh: : 嗯，要是你把我转圈什么的，我大概会吐。不过你到目前为止还没干过，所以除非你新培养了什么奇怪的爱好……

lines.en: : Spinning isn’t really an interest of mine. But I could pick you up and put you down on your bed if you want to get some rest.
lines.zh: : 转圈确实不是我的兴趣。不过如果你想要休息，我可以把你抱起来放到床上。

lines.en: scene iokotatsu5
: Oooooooor...we could use the kotatsu I just fixed so you don’t have to throw me over a bunch of obstacles and risk knocking the rest of my stuff down.
lines.zh: : 或——者——说……我们可以用我刚修好的暖桌，这样你就不用把我从一堆障碍物上面扔过去、冒着我剩下的东西被撞倒的风险了。

lines.en: : It also gives us an excuse for me to lay on your lap and have you pat my head.
lines.zh: : 而且这样我就能顺理成章地躺在你腿上、让你摸我的头了。

lines.en: : What if you’re not sick at all and this is just one elaborate ploy to obtain a lap pillow?
lines.zh: : 万一你根本没病，这一切只是为了骗一个膝枕而精心设计的呢？

lines.en: : Then I am a much better actor than I thought I was.
lines.zh: : 那我的演技可比我自己以为的好太多了。

lines.en: : Io-
lines.zh: : Io——

lines.en: : Come oooooooon. It’s really warm under there. And I’m super light. You won’t even know I’m on you.
lines.zh: : 拜——托——啦。底下真的很暖和。而且我超轻。你根本感觉不到我压在你身上。

lines.en: : I have no problem with you being “on” me. I’m just having a hard time telling you that I think we should maybe talk about all of these medications.
lines.zh: : 你「压」着我我没意见。我只是很难开口告诉你——我觉得我们也许该好好谈谈这堆药。

lines.en: : Are you a doctor?
lines.zh: : 你是医生吗？

lines.en: : I’m not.
lines.zh: : 我不是。

lines.en: : Well then what good will talking about my medications do for either of us?
lines.zh: : 那谈我的药对咱俩有什么好处？

lines.en: : I’m fine. I’ve got a bunch of stuff that I can take for certain things whenever I need to take them.
lines.zh: : 我没事的。我有一堆药，什么时候需要就什么时候吃。

lines.en: : I just happened to need several different things tonight and, mixed with the fact that I haven’t eaten at all and how I barely slept last night-
lines.zh: : 只是今晚恰好需要吃好几种，再加上我一口东西都没吃、昨晚又几乎没睡——

lines.en: : Boom. Down goes Io.
lines.zh: : 砰。Io 倒下了。

lines.en: : Hah...
scene black
I sigh to myself and accept that Io’s probably not going to give me any specific details tonight.
lines.zh: 我暗自叹了口气，接受今晚大概问不出什么具体细节了。

lines.en: But I think it’s pretty safe to assume that it’s nothing physical if she only takes them when she needs to and-
lines.zh: 不过如果她只是需要时才吃，我想基本可以断定不是什么身体上的毛病——而且——

lines.en: Well, I guess they could still technically be painkillers or something.
lines.zh: 嗯，严格来说它们也可能是止痛药之类的。

lines.en: Damn it.
lines.zh: 该死。

lines.en: Why did she have to pick now to get all light headed?
lines.zh: 她为什么偏偏挑现在头晕？

lines.en: scene iokotatsu6
I turn off the lights before moving over to the kotatsu and sliding myself underneath it.
lines.zh: 我关了灯，走到暖桌旁，钻到下面去。

lines.en: Io waits on her step ladder until I’m in place and then very slowly and clumsily climbs onto me, resting her body in my lap and her head on my chest.
lines.zh: Io 在她的小梯子上等着，直到我到位，然后非常缓慢而笨拙地爬到我身上，把身子躺在我腿上、头靠在我胸口。

lines.en: It’s a position that makes me acutely aware that I must focus at least half of my energy on not getting an erection because it would be overwhelmingly apparent to her if I did.
lines.zh: 这个姿势让我清醒地意识到，我至少得把一半精力用在「不要勃起」上——因为我要是勃起了，她一定会发现得不能再明显。

lines.en: I stabilize myself with my left hand and use my right one to softly rub her shoulder.
lines.zh: 我用左手稳住自己，右手轻轻揉着她的肩膀。

lines.en: It’s not something I’d normally have any interest in doing, but...given the context of the situation, I think it’s okay for me to be a little nice.
lines.zh: 平时我可没兴趣做这种事，不过……考虑到现在的情况，我觉得稍微温柔一点也无妨。

lines.en: At least until she’s able to stand on her own two feet again.
lines.zh: 至少撑到她能自己站起来为止。

lines.en: As soon as that happens, she can rub her own shoulder.
lines.zh: 等她能站起来了，她自己揉去。

lines.en: : Guh...sleepy...
: One of the downsides to pretty much every single anxiety medication is how tired they make you.
lines.zh: 几乎每一种抗焦虑药都有一个副作用——让你犯困。

lines.en: Ahh, so it {i}wasn't{/i} anything physical.
lines.zh: 啊，所以{i}不是{/i}身体上的问题。

lines.en: Shocker.
lines.zh: 真意外。

lines.en: : You have anxiety?
lines.zh: : 你有焦虑症？

lines.en: : Amongst other things.
lines.zh: : 除了其他种种。

lines.en: : Was the anxiety part not obvious to you?
lines.zh: : 焦虑那部分你没看出来吗？

lines.en: : I probably could have guessed. It just sounded rude to say something like, “I thought so.”
lines.zh: : 我大概猜得到。只是说「我早就这么想了」之类的话听起来太失礼了。

lines.en: : Well, thank you for your sudden increase in generosity.
lines.zh: : 嗯，谢谢您突然变得这么体贴。

lines.en: : Maybe I should just always invite you over before I take my meds to reap the benefits of being {i}your{/i} student.
lines.zh: : 也许我该每次吃药前都把你叫来，好享受当{i}你{/i}的学生的好处。

lines.en: : What’s with the emphasis on “your?”
lines.zh: : 你为什么把「你的」说得那么重？

lines.en: : There aren’t many teachers who would let an anxious, loopy, drugged out [teenager] climb into their lap.
lines.zh: : 没多少老师会让一个焦虑、晕乎乎、磕了药的[teenager]爬到他们腿上去。

lines.en: : Yeah. Ms. Watabe would have never let you do this with her.
lines.zh: : 是啊。换成 Watabe 老师可绝不会让你这么干。

lines.en: : Good. Because I wouldn’t {i}want{/i} to do this with Ms. Watabe.
lines.zh: : 很好。因为我也{i}不想{/i}跟 Watabe 老师这样。

lines.en: : You, on the other hand...
lines.zh: : 不过换成你……

lines.en: : I could do this every night for the rest of my life and not get tired of it.
lines.zh: : 我可以一辈子每晚都这样，也不会腻。

lines.en: : Io?
lines.zh: : Io？

lines.en: : Yeah?
: Why do you like me so much?
lines.zh: : 你为什么这么喜欢我？

lines.en: scene iokotatsu7
: Because I have to.
lines.zh: : 因为我必须喜欢。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Because you’re my last bastion of hope for adults in this world.
lines.zh: : 因为你是我对这世界上成年人最后的希望堡垒。

lines.en: : I am so tired of everyone else that if things don’t work out with you, I’ll probably just die.
lines.zh: : 我已经对其他所有人厌倦透顶；要是跟你之间也没个结果，我大概就死了。

lines.en: : Oh, okay. That doesn’t put all of the pressure in the world on my shoulders or anything.
lines.zh: : 哦，好啊。这可一点都没把全世界的压力压到我肩膀上呢。

lines.en: : You’ve already got the rest of me weighing down on you. Might as well go for the shoulders, too.
lines.zh: : 我整个人都已经压在你身上了，干脆连肩膀一起压上吧。

lines.en: scene iokotatsu8
: That was kind of just a joke anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正刚才那句也就是个玩笑。

lines.en: : You really are my last line of defense, though.
lines.zh: : 不过，你真的是我最后一道防线。

lines.en: : And probably the only example of something that I’ve wanted that I’ve actually made a push for.
lines.zh: : 大概也是我唯一一个真正主动争取过的、想要的东西。

lines.en: : Some push you’re making, nearly passing out in front of me.
lines.zh: : 争取得可真够厉害的，都快在我面前晕过去了。

lines.en: : There have been other pushes. This one was just a convenient coincidence.
lines.zh: : 别的争取也有过。这次只是个凑巧的巧合。

lines.en: : If I’m being completely honest, Sensei...I don’t know why it was you who appealed to me.
lines.zh: : 说实话，Sensei……我不知道为什么吸引我的人是你。

lines.en: : You were probably just in the right place at the right time.
lines.zh: : 你大概只是恰好在对的时间出现在对的地点。

lines.en: : So it could have been anyone?
lines.zh: : 所以换谁都行？

lines.en: scene iokotatsu9
: It could have been anyone.
lines.zh: : 换谁都行。

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: : 不过……

lines.en: : I’m glad it was you.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴那个人是你。

lines.en: scene iokotatsu10
: Uta’s home!
lines.zh: : Uta 回来了！

lines.en: : Welcome back. Don’t mind us.
lines.zh: : 欢迎回来。别管我们。

lines.en: : Uta’s not home! Please carry on!
lines.zh: : Uta 不在家！请继续！

lines.en: : Wait, no. Stay.
lines.zh: : 等等，不。别走。

lines.en: : I want you here.
lines.zh: : 我想让你在这儿。

lines.en: scene iokotatsu11
: Uhh...
: Pleeeeeease?
: I...don’t know...
lines.zh: : 我……不知道……

lines.en: : Like...this seems like something I probably shouldn’t get involved in...
lines.zh: : 就是……这看起来像是我大概不该掺和的事……

lines.en: : I think you’re misunderstanding the situation.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你误会了。

lines.en: scene iokotatsu12
: Did you take too much again?
lines.zh: : 你又吃多了？

lines.en: : Oh. Or you completely understand the situation.
lines.zh: : 哦。或者你完全明白状况。

lines.en: : After a few seconds of actually thinkin’ about it, yeah.
lines.zh: : 认真想了几秒钟之后，是的。

lines.en: : How are you feeling? Do you need any water? Juice?
lines.zh: : 你现在感觉怎么样？要水吗？果汁？

lines.en: : I’m okay now that Sensei’s letting me use his lap.
lines.zh: : Sensei 肯把腿借给我，我就没事了。

lines.en: : Good...I’m glad...
lines.zh: : 那就好……我很高兴……

lines.en: : Hang in there.
lines.zh: : 撑住啊。

lines.en: scene iokotatsu13
: Welp! I’ll leave you two kids to it, then! I’ve got no job to do here and my presence will just be a bother!
lines.zh: : 好嘞！那我就不打扰你们两个小朋友了！我在这儿也没事干，待着只会碍事！

lines.en: : Hey, no. I really do want you to stay. It’s totally fine.
lines.zh: : 嘿，别。我是真的想让你留下。完全没问题的。

lines.en: : Nope! I’m out!
lines.zh: : 不！我走了！

lines.en: : Don’t...do anything crazy without...calling your aunt!
lines.zh: : 别……做什么疯狂的事之前……先给你姑姑打个电话！

lines.en: scene iokotatsu14
Uta leaves just as quickly as she arrived.
lines.zh: Uta 来得快，走得也快。

lines.en: Where she ran off to, I have no idea. But I guess this means that I have a little more time alone with Io.
lines.zh: 她跑去哪儿了，我完全不知道。不过我想，这意味着我能跟 Io 多独处一会儿。

lines.en: : I really did want her to stay...
lines.zh: : 我是真的想让她留下来的……

lines.en: : She probably just felt uncomfortable seeing her friend cuddled up against her teacher.
lines.zh: : 她大概只是看到自己的朋友窝在老师怀里，觉得不自在吧。

lines.en: : Probably.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。

lines.en: scene iokotatsu15
: It’s admittedly not a thing either of us have any real experience with.
lines.zh: : 说实话，这种事我们俩都没什么真正的经验。

lines.en: : Didn’t Uta think you were a boy when you two first started talking?
lines.zh: : Uta 一开始跟你说话的时候，不是以为你是男生吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. And I thought she was a boy too.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我也以为她是男生。

lines.en: : But just because we thought each other were the opposite gender doesn’t mean we have any notable experience with said gender.
lines.zh: : 可就算我们互相都以为对方是异性，也不代表我们对那个性别有什么值得一提的经验。

lines.en: : It’s just weird that you make an exception to your “no girls” rule for her when she’s one of the girliest girls I’ve ever met. That’s all I’m saying.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得奇怪——你明明立了「不要女生」的规矩，却为她破例，而她又是我见过最女生的女生之一。我就是这么说说。

lines.en: : It is weird, yeah.
lines.zh: : 是挺奇怪的，嗯。

lines.en: scene iokotatsu16
: But I really look up to Uta.
lines.zh: : 但我真的很仰慕 Uta。

lines.en: : She’s amazing.
lines.zh: : 她特别厉害。

lines.en: : In what way?
lines.zh: : 哪方面？

lines.en: : In that she got better.
lines.zh: : 她变好了。

lines.en: : In that she can wake up and put a real smile on. And hold real conversations with all sorts of people.
lines.zh: : 她能醒来就挂上一个真心的笑容。还能跟各种各样的人进行真正的对话。

lines.en: : In that she can organize a classwide, two-day event on a whim and pull the entire thing off without so much as a drop of sweat.
lines.zh: : 她能一时兴起就组织一场全班的两天活动，然后把整件事办成，连一滴汗都不流。

lines.en: : In that she’s pretty and sweet and doesn’t use that as a front to get what she wants from people.
lines.zh: : 她又漂亮又温柔，却不把这些当幌子去从别人那里换取自己想要的东西。

lines.en: : You clearly have not spent enough time at the maid cafe.
lines.zh: : 你显然在女仆咖啡厅待得还不够久。

lines.en: : That's a job. It doesn't count.
lines.zh: : 那是工作。不算数。

lines.en: : Uta’s the perfect girl.
lines.zh: : Uta 是完美的女孩。

lines.en: : I hate it so much.
lines.zh: : 我恨死这一点了。

lines.en: : But I also {i}love{/i} her so much.
lines.zh: : 可我也{i}爱死{/i}她了。

lines.en: : And I probably wouldn’t be here without her.
lines.zh: : 而且要是没有她，我大概也不会在这儿。

lines.en: scene iokotatsu17
: And I’m not joking this time, by the way.
lines.zh: : 顺便说一句，这次我可不是在开玩笑。

lines.en: : I would very likely be dead if I never met Uta.
lines.zh: : 要是从来没遇到过 Uta，我大概早就死了。

lines.en: : She...seems like a great friend.
lines.zh: : 她……看起来是个很棒的朋友。

lines.en: I’m not really sure what else I’m supposed to say to that.
lines.zh: 我真不知道除此之外还能说什么。

lines.en: Io’s always spewing out a corrosive mixture of positivity and negativity that blend just about as well together as bleach and ammonia.
lines.zh: Io 总是在往外喷一种正负情绪混合的腐蚀性液体，两者融合得就跟漂白剂和氨水一样。

lines.en: The room fills up with fumes that my lungs can’t handle, and I slowly die with my hand still clasped around her shoulder.
lines.zh: 房间里弥漫着我肺受不了的毒气，而我就这么慢慢死去，手还搭在她肩膀上。

lines.en: : She’s the best friend.
lines.zh: : 她是最好的朋友。

lines.en: : I just wish I could give her more than {i}me{/i}, you know? Like, I suck. She can do so much better.
lines.zh: : 我只是希望自己能给她的不止「{i}我{/i}」这个人，你懂吧？比如，我很烂。她值得更好的。

lines.en: : Yeah, you’re pretty terrible.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你挺糟糕的。

lines.en: : But you’re also great in your own ways too.
lines.zh: : 但你也用自己的方式很棒。

lines.en: : Like what? Tell me some.
lines.zh: : 比如什么？说几个听听。

lines.en: : Like...you’re light.
lines.zh: : 比如……你很轻。

lines.en: : You can lay here and I can’t even feel you.
lines.zh: : 你躺在这儿，我几乎感觉不到你。

lines.en: : Uh-huh. And what else?
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。还有呢？

lines.en: : That’s it.
lines.zh: : 没了。

lines.en: : That’s all I’ve got.
lines.zh: : 我就这些了。

lines.en: : I can settle for that. That’s fair.
lines.zh: : 我能接受。挺公平的。

lines.en: scene iokotatsu18
: It would probably be nice if you thought a little higher of yourself, though.
lines.zh: : 不过，你要是把自己看得高一点，大概会好些。

lines.en: : I have to do something worthy of being praised for before I can even think of praising myself.
lines.zh: : 我得先做出点值得被夸的事，才谈得上夸自己。

lines.en: : Right now, I’m just a weightless, overmedicated cockroach with a grand total of two bras and four boxcutters.
lines.zh: : 现在，我不过是一只没有重量的、用药过量的蟑螂，总共只有两件胸罩和四把美工刀。

lines.en: : Why do you have four boxcutters? And why do you only have two bras?
lines.zh: : 你为什么有四把美工刀？又为什么只有两件胸罩？

lines.en: : Do you want to buy me more?
lines.zh: : 你想给我买更多吗？

lines.en: : Bras or boxcutters?
lines.zh: : 胸罩还是美工刀？

lines.en: : Why would I need three bras? I can just wash them.
lines.zh: : 我为什么要三件胸罩？洗洗不就行了。

lines.en: : Why would you need five-
lines.zh: : 那你为什么需要五把——

lines.en: : You know, what? Nevermind.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗？算了。

lines.en: : Just...do yourself a favor and...eat before you take your medication next time.
lines.zh: : 就……帮自己个忙……下次吃药前先吃点东西。

lines.en: : I make no promises, Sensei. Sometimes, I just don’t want to eat.
lines.zh: : 我不保证，Sensei。有时候我就是不想吃。

lines.en: : Well then don’t take your medication those days.
lines.zh: : 那那些天就别吃药。

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s probably an even worse idea than the not eating thing.
lines.zh: : 是啊，那大概比不吃饭还糟。

lines.en: : Why do you have to be so difficult?
lines.zh: : 你为什么非得这么难搞？

lines.en: : Why do everyone’s standards for “easy” have to be so hard to reach?
lines.zh: : 为什么每个人对「好相处」的标准都这么难达到？

lines.en: : You’d think that “easy” would imply a complete lack of difficulty, but being easy to deal with takes a lot of work. Probably.
lines.zh: : 你会以为「好相处」意味着完全没有难度，可要做到好相处，大概得花很多功夫。

lines.en: : I don’t know. I’m definitely not the right person to ask.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我肯定不是该问的人。

lines.en: : I just hope that you're okay with me being the way I am, because I like this a lot.
lines.zh: : 我只是希望你能接受我这个样子，因为我真的很喜欢现在这样。

lines.en: : In fact, I like it so much, I’m gonna take a nap.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我太喜欢了，我要睡个午觉。

lines.en: : Goodnight, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 晚安，Sensei。

lines.en: : Goodnight.
lines.zh: : 晚安。

lines.en: scene black
I think about shooting some snarky retort at Io about how I wouldn’t have come here if she was just going to fall asleep on me-
lines.zh: 我想刻薄地回 Io 一句，说要是她就这么睡在我身上，我根本不会来——

lines.en: But her forehead is basically a space heater right now.
lines.zh: 可她的额头现在简直就是个取暖器。

lines.en: And her body, despite being light as air, is the same way.
lines.zh: 而她的身体虽然轻得像空气，也同样烫。

lines.en: I’m flattered that she was able to carry on such a lengthy conversation with me despite showing all signs of not being well-
lines.zh: 她明明浑身都写着不舒服，却还能跟我聊这么久，我挺受宠若惊的——

lines.en: But not thinking about herself will wind up killing her.
lines.zh: 可她这么不为自己着想，迟早会害死她。

lines.en: In fact, thinking {i}too much{/i} about herself will also wind up killing her.
lines.zh: 事实上，为自己想得{i}太多{/i}，同样会害死她。

lines.en: Io is practically dead already.
lines.zh: Io 其实已经跟死掉差不多了。

lines.en: And there is no one who deserves rest quite like the dead.
lines.zh: 而没有谁比死人更配得上休息了。

lines.en: So I let her fall asleep.
lines.zh: 所以我由着她睡去。

lines.en: And after she doesn’t wake up for the next hour, I carefully pick her up and lay her down on Uta’s bed, since that one is actually possible to reach.
lines.zh: 接下来一个小时她都没醒，我便小心翼翼地把她抱起来，放到 Uta 的床上——因为那张床是真的够得到。

lines.en: And then I leave without checking the labels on any of her mystery bottles.
lines.zh: 然后我离开了，没有去查看她那些神秘药瓶上的任何标签。
